title: fix(service-settings)!: a settings value that misses its type's declared format is refused at the save door and the env door
body:
Fixes #24882

Clause-②: no (narrowing)

This PR lands the card's last half: both settings doors now refuse a value that misses the format its type declares. PR #25001 (`91e728669`) landed the warning half. The console half is objectstack-ai/objectui#13287.

## What changes

ADR-0007 declares a format for four specifier types: `email`, `url` and `phone` take "format validation", and `color` takes a hex string. PR #25001 added one shared verdict, `firstFormatMiss(type, value)`, which already carries the ADR-0114 code for each type. This PR changes its two call sites in `packages/services/service-settings/src/settings-service.ts` from warning to refusal. The grammars are unchanged.

- **The save door (`validatePatch`).** A miss pushes one `FieldError` for the key, with the verdict's code (`invalid_email`, `invalid_url`, `invalid_phone`, or `invalid_format` for `color`), and `continue`s like every other family. The route answers through the existing `SETTINGS_VALIDATION` envelope: `400`, with the entry in `error.details.fields`. Nothing in the save is stored. The format is still judged last, so a value that also breaks another family (a length bound, a pattern) is refused for that family.
  - The message names the expected format, for example `Logo URL must be a well-formed URL (scheme://…, a root-relative /path, a data: URI or a blob: URL).` It never echoes the value, so the entry carries no `value` member.
  - `constraint` is `{ type: 'url' }` and so on. This is the existing `FieldError.constraint` member, keyed by the declaring property as the pattern branch's `{ pattern }` is. It lets a client tell a colour's `invalid_format` from a declared pattern's.
- **The env door (`effectiveEnvOverride`).** A miss is rejected through `reportRejectedEnvOverride`, the same reporter every other family uses. The override is not in force, the line is logged once per (variable, value) at `error`, and the key is no longer locked. The reporter gains one optional fragment, `shape`. When it is set, the line carries the value's length and never the value, for any key, not only an encrypted one. `auditEnvOverrides` still walks format-typed keys, so the line arrives at boot.
- **Removed:** the warning reporter `reportEnvFormatMiss`, its dedupe set, the save door's `formatMisses` list and its post-accept `warn` loop.

No response member is added, and nothing outside `service-settings` changes. No organization predicate or rung resolution is touched.

## 「甲」 reading (amended)

The standing rule 「甲」 (#6015, comment 6292005854), as the maintainer amended it (comment 6303865025, quoting 「暂时不考虑 v19，协议的调整原则上也是尽快，不考虑退役版本。」):

> Rule 2 changes: a narrowing that no conversion carries ALSO ships now, in 18.x, as a BREAKING minor (the #24813 changeset shape); no refusal is filed for 19.0, and no `pm:on-hold` card waits on a 19.0 line. The warning half alone is no longer the 18.x deliverable.

The seat's derivation for this card (comment 6302777692) still holds on its facts:

- Refusing these values narrows what the settings door accepts.
- No ADR-0087 conversion can carry it. Stored values are runtime state in `sys_setting`, and an `OS_*` override is a deployment's environment.

Under the amended rule 2, that narrowing ships now. The seat re-timed the card on that reading (comment 6304784014). So this PR is a BREAKING `minor`:

- the changeset declares `Clause-②: no (narrowing)`;
- its ADR-0087 disposition is `not-required (no-migration-prescription)`, accepted by `check-adr-0087-registration --base origin/main`;
- the narrowing owes a contract review at `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER` before the queue (claim comment 6304887064).

## Measured first

**Stored rows.** A value already stored that misses its format was measured on every shipped format-typed key and on the synthetic `phone` key. Each was stored as `text`, then the real manifest was registered over it, the method the option-table and value-domain TOUCH pins use.

- **Reads serve it.** `get()` and `GET /api/settings/:namespace` return it unchanged. Reads judge nothing. This was expected.
- **A save of another key in the same namespace is not blocked.** For example, `branding.workspace_name` saves over a stored malformed `logo_url`, and `mail.from_name` saves over a stored `no-reply@localhost`. This was expected: the save door judges only the keys a save touches.
- Only a save that writes the key judges it. The malformed value is refused, a well-formed one replaces it, and an all-null reset clears it.
- **One precision on "touches".** `validatePatch`'s TOUCH gate also counts a key whose `visible` predicate reads a patched key. A synthetic `url` key gated on `mode` is judged when `mode` is saved and it stays visible. That rule is the same for every family. No shipped format-typed key declares `visible`, so no shipped namespace is affected. It is pinned so the reading is exact.

**The env door's fallback.** A rejected override contributes nothing, so the key resolves from the next layer: the stored value when one exists, else the manifest default. None of the five shipped format-typed keys declares a default, so the default is `null`. Reads report that layer as the source, and the key is no longer locked. Both legs are pinned. The changeset states this for operators.

## Pending release note corrected

This PR deletes `.changeset/24882-settings-format-warning.md`, PR #25001's changeset, and replaces it with `.changeset/24882-settings-format-refusal.md`.

- **What it said.** The pending note says a malformed save "is still accepted", that an override "stays in force", that a `warn` line is logged, and that refusal "waits for the next major version".
- **Why it is now false.** This PR changes every one of those statements. No release has consumed the note: `@objectstack/service-settings` is at `18.0.0`, and its `CHANGELOG.md` has no entry for it.
- **Why it is replaced, not left beside the new one.** Keeping it would publish two contradictory entries in one release.

This is the DELIBERATE CORRECTION class that `check-empty-changeset.mjs` names. Its foreign-changeset refusal is red by design here, and `Check Changeset` will show red. The remedy that gate prescribes is this paragraph: the note and what changed under it, put on the PR for confirmation. The note is not restored, and no `skip-changeset` is applied.

## Tests

The pin file is renamed: `settings-format-warning.test.ts` becomes `settings-format-refusal.test.ts`, with 41 cases.

- The save door is driven through the real route (`registerSettingsRoutes` over a real `SettingsService`). Status starts at 0, so every status is asserted, not defaulted.
- The env door is driven through `get`, `getNamespace`, the `GET` route and the `PUT` lock.

What the pins hold:

- **Save door, per type.** Every shipped key with a format type (`branding.logo_url`, `company.website`, `branding.accent_color`, `company.primary_contact_email`, `mail.from_email`) and a synthetic `phone` key are covered.
  - A malformed value answers `400 SETTINGS_VALIDATION` with exactly one field error: `field`, ADR-0114 `code`, `constraint.type`, no `value`, and it parses under `FieldErrorSchema`. Nothing is stored, and no log line is written.
  - A well-formed value saves.
- **Save door, other cases.**
  - The other shapes each grammar admits still save, and empty and blank values are not judged.
  - A secret-bearing key's answer carries neither the value nor any fragment of it.
  - Precedence: a value that breaks a length bound is refused for the bound. A batch with one malformed key is refused whole.
- **Env door, per type.**
  - A malformed override is not in force: source `default`, `locked: false`, no `env` entry in the cascade chain.
  - It is reported exactly once, at boot, and re-reads do not repeat it. The line never carries the value.
  - A save of the key then succeeds and is served from the stored value.
  - A well-formed override is in force and locks the key with `409`.
- **Env door, other cases.** A malformed override set over a stored value leaves the stored value answering. A secret-bearing key's line carries no fragment of the value. An override that breaks a length bound is rejected for the bound.
- **Stored rows.** The measurements above, per type, plus the reset and the `visible`-TOUCH pin.

Readings on the final head `58d0be84f`, each through `scripts/pm/os-verify-lock.sh` (`VERDICT command-exit 0`):

- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings run typecheck`: exit 0. The program includes the new test (`tsc --listFiles`, 57 test files).
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/service-settings exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2`: 57 files, 970 tests passed.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/plugin-auth exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `auth-settings-ordering.pin`, `auth-settings-seeded-boot.pin` and `auth-settings-refusal-isolation`: 3 files, 13 tests passed. Their config aliases `service-settings` to source.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/dogfood exec vitest run --maxWorkers=2` over `test/settings-audit-global-rung-sibling`, `test/settings-config-change-audit` and `test/settings-organization-isolation`: 3 files, 14 tests passed. The rebuilt `service-settings` dist carries the refusal. No dogfood fixture saves a format-typed key.

## Ablations

Each leg ran with the implementation committed, on the file blob `ae561682b08a`. The mutation went through `node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode, which proves the anchor fell 1 to 0 and the blob changed on disk. The restore after every leg is proven: blob == HEAD (`ae561682b08a`) and an empty `git diff HEAD`. The tests import the service from source, so no `dist/` is involved.

| leg | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | the verdict accepts everything | 24 of 41 red: every refusal pin at both doors, both secret pins, the batch and precedence pins, the re-save step of every stored-row pin and the `visible`-TOUCH pin (`expected 200 to be 400`, `expected 'env' to be 'default'`). The 17 green are the well-formed, other-shape, empty, reset, fixture and env-precedence pins. |
| A2 | the env line prints the value (the `shape` branch disabled) | 7 red: every non-secret env malformed pin and the stored-value fallback pin (`expected '… env override …' not to contain 'not a url'`). The secret pin stays green because the encrypted-key redaction still applies, as expected. |
| A3 | the save door's field error carries `value` | 7 red: the six save malformed pins (`to not have property "value"`) and the secret save pin (`not to contain 'billing-desk-at-corp-internal'`). |
| A4 | the TOUCH gate removed | 9 red: the six stored-row "not blocked" pins (`expected 400 to be 200`) and three `mail` pins that then trip unrelated required keys. This shows the stored-row pins can fail. |

A3's first attempt was a no-op that the tool refused: the replacement contained the anchor, so the anchor count did not fall. It was re-run with a non-overlapping replacement. The table records only the leg that landed.

## Gates

Gate commands were derived from this worktree with `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack` (no paths) on `58d0be84f`: 67 commands, the same set as the PM's reading at `93e6c1a5f`. Each ran locally with its exit code captured before any pipe.

- `--ran` reconciliation: 67 derived, 67 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, 0 UNRUN.
- 65 exited 0.
- `node scripts/check-empty-changeset.mjs --base origin/main` exited 1. This is the designed red for the deliberate correction above.
- `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exited 3 (PREREQUISITE NOT MET, no dist) on the battery. It was re-run with exit 0 after a full turbo build (112 entries across 69 packages load).
- `check:dts-closure` and `check:sourcemap-no-sources-content` re-ran with exit 0 over the full build (76 and 72 packages).
- The roster gates whose roster sits under a path of this diff ran with exit 0: `check-changeset-fixed.mjs`, `check:authz-resolver`, `check:error-code-casing` and `check:filter-alias-parity`.

CI owns the families outside that list.

## Acceptance notes

- `content/docs/deployment/environment-variables.mdx` says the settings layer's `OS_BRANDING_LOGO_URL` / `OS_BRANDING_ACCENT_COLOR` outrank a saved value and lock the field. That stays true for a well-formed value. The page does not say a malformed one is now ignored. Docs are outside this card's file surface. Owner: none.
- The host-level `OS_LOGO_URL` / `OS_BRAND_COLOR` that `RuntimeConfigPlugin` reads are a different reader and are not judged by the settings door. This is unchanged here. Owner: none.
- `origin/main` moved one commit after the merge (`aaee0840b`, `plugin-security` only). It was not re-merged, so the measured head stays `58d0be84f`.
